text: {"lessons":["Selling winners has felt rewarding, but I should base exits on my plan and the stock’s prospects—not just the pleasure of locking in a gain.","I sold Stock B at a loss after buying it back at a higher price; I should reassess losing positions honestly rather than cling to them to avoid admitting a mistake.","I should avoid letting daily account checks prompt impulsive trades; pause, follow clear rules, and consider the risk before buying or selling."]}
